_about: Prices on this site that come from public USDA AMS Market News reports. Updated weekly by .github/workflows/update-prices.yml (tools/update_prices.py). Edit by hand only if you also run `python3 tools/update_prices.py apply`.

bred_cow.label: Bred cow purchase price
bred_cow.report_name: Cattlemen's Livestock, Dalhart TX weekly auction
bred_cow.rule: BRED COWS, Medium & Large 1 (not 1-2), 2-4 yr, 2nd trimester; head-weighted average of matching lines
bred_cow.detail_html: Cattlemen's Livestock, Dalhart TX (ams_1953.pdf) — "BRED COWS, Medium & Large 1" line, 17 hd, 1,243–1,327 lb, $2,800–$2,850/hd

fed_cattle.label: Fed/finished cattle sale price
fed_cattle.report_name: 5 Area Weekly Weighted Average Direct Slaughter Cattle (LM_CT150)
fed_cattle.rule: Live FOB steers, Over 80% Choice, weighted average
fed_cattle.detail_html: USDA AMS "5 Area Weekly Weighted Average Direct Slaughter Cattle" (ams_2477.pdf) — live FOB steers, Over 80% Choice, $218–$223/cwt, weighted avg, 1,606 lb, 19,383 hd

bred_heifer.label: Bred heifer sale price
bred_heifer.rule: BRED HEIFERS, Medium & Large 1 (not 1-2), any age/stage; head-weighted average of matching lines
bred_heifer.detail_html: USDA AMS "Texas Weekly Cattle Auction Summary" (ams_1955.pdf) — "BRED HEIFERS, Medium & Large 1": 20 hd, under 2 yr, 2nd trimester, avg 1,014 lb, $3,625.00/hd (the only Medium & Large 1 line that week)
